purpose: Describe rating-1/rating-4 oriented top-20% spatial patterns and compare them with the already generated k=6 Layer-CAM group maps. No new model fitting or formal spatial inference.

selection.count_rule: ceil(fraction * shared_mask_voxels); deterministic stable value-rank tie breaking
selection.haufe_rating4_direction: largest positive values of the signed rating4-minus-rating1 Haufe map
selection.haufe_rating1_direction: largest values of the sign-reversed Haufe map, equivalent to the most negative values of the signed Haufe map
selection.layercam_direction: largest values of the existing manuscript Layer-CAM TFCE-FWE-masked subject-level t map; this exactly matches the existing Layer-CAM top-20% visualization convention
selection.layercam_continuous_map: the separately reported continuous correlation uses the frozen non-negative class-specific group-mean Layer-CAM attribution map

comparison.spatial_domain: intersection of frozen Haufe and Layer-CAM common masks
comparison.interpretation_boundary: Haufe maps are signed linear-SVM input-pattern mappings from k=1 trial-level data. Layer-CAM maps are non-negative model-attribution maps from correctly classified k=6 condition-average inputs. Their comparison is descriptive and does not establish activation, causal regional contribution, or condition-specific neural differences.

roi_description.role: descriptive atlas labeling of selected voxels only; no ROI inferential test
